name: SEED GERMINATOR
desc: 150-Liter Microprocessor-Controlled Seed Germination Chamber engineered to optimize the sprouting and development workflows of diverse seed varieties. Features a robust SS304 internal chamber with integrated day/night fluorescent photoperiod simulation lighting.
features: Full-Spectrum Fluorescent Grow Lights for day/night cycle simulation
Precise temperature regulation down to 10°C baseline (Range: 10°C to 50°C)
Controlled baseline humidity configuration stabilizing at 50% RH
4 Heavy-Duty Adjustable Shelves for varying seed tray sizes
Advanced Microprocessor-Based Digital Temperature & Humidity Controller
